messages.author: 7089b59d02f5edd5
messages.subject: GSoC 2012: Convert Matlab code to R
parts:
Hello

I am Sahil Shah. I am interested in participating in GSoC 2012 by contributing to the R language project. I have always been interested in machine learning but am fairly new to R, however I am learning it. I have used Matlab before and coded machine learning algorithms like ID3 decision trees etc in it and also done some feature selection coding. I have also used external libraries like libSVM to run SVM classifiers in Matlab am also familiar with finance and thus found the following project pretty interesting. 

Convert Meucci's Matlab Code to R

It would be great if you could guide me with and help me out a bit. 

Regards
 
Sincerely
Sahil Shah

Thank you for your interest in R GSoC 2012.

I think the key way to prepare for an application for the proposed
Meucci project would be to become familiar with the Meucci papers
referenced in the project idea page, and to look closely at the 'Test'
section. Since you have indicated you have little familiarity with R,
it will be critical to a successful application for you to demonstrate
that you have acquired some proficiency with R and the relevant packages
and can reflect that in your student application.

Regards,

- Brian
